name: Variable Age-Onset Epilepsy Syndrome

criteria.description: Documented clinical seizures with variable age of onset
EEG demonstrating epileptiform discharges consistent with epilepsy
Exclusion of other structural, metabolic, or genetic causes of epilepsy
History of seizure onset at variable ages within affected family members or individuals

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical seizures with EEG abnormalities and exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies on clinical and EEG findings with careful exclusion of alternative etiologies.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Focal onset seizures with impaired awareness

searchTerms: memory and attention issues between seizures

occasional.symptomName: Autonomic symptoms during seizures (e.g., pallor, sweating)
searchTerms: pale skin and sweating during seizures
autonomic signs like sweating in seizures

occasional.symptomName: Psychiatric manifestations such as anxiety or depression

searchTerms: temporary weakness on one side after seizure
visual warning signs prior to seizures

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; metabolic screening to exclude secondary causes
imaging: Brain MRI typically normal or nonspecific findings; used to exclude structural lesions
genetic: Possible familial inheritance patterns; no single causative gene identified
other: EEG showing interictal epileptiform discharges or seizure activity

distinguishingFeatures: Specific EEG pattern with generalized polyspike and wave
MRI evidence of mesial temporal sclerosis

redFlags: Sudden onset of focal neurological deficits
Prolonged seizures lasting more than 5 minutes
Rapid cognitive decline or behavioral changes
references: Orphanet: Variable Age-Onset Epilepsy Syndrome, ORPHA:699645
Fisher RS, et al. Epileptic seizures and epilepsy: definitions proposed by the International League Against Epilepsy (ILAE) and the International Bureau for Epilepsy (IBE). Epilepsia. 2005
Berg AT, et al. Revised terminology and concepts for organization of seizures and epilepsies: report of the ILAE Commission on Classification and Terminology, 2005-2009. Epilepsia. 2010
